messages:
jorge: FYI ran a qint8 bringup against the multilingual promptset this morning. dedupe produced lots of isolated near-duplicates for long SQL/JSON blobs in es/zh/pt. looks like tokenboundary shifts + emoji broke our fuzzyhash.

rachel: ugh. any quick repro or a sample?

jorge: pasted one. tokens changed around emoji and non-ascii quotes.

jorge: ```
input: "SELECT * FROM users WHERE name LIKE \"%João%\" -- returns rows
-- original: smart quotes vs straight quotes changed token count

{
  \"user\": \"João\",
  \"bio\": \"工程师 👩‍💻 works on infra\"
}
```

mei: that makes sense. qint8 tokenizer packing merges surrogate pairs and some punctuation differently. fuzzyhash (ngram) relies on consistent token boundaries.

mei: short-term: we can run a hybrid dedupe pass that uses fp32-token-hash + embedding-similarity. if fp32 hash matches, treat as dup. otherwise fallback to embedding cosine > 0.92. low false-positive risk for long structured samples.

rachel: can you sketch the command/config? i'll add a flag to the dedupe job.

mei: sample config snippet:```
# tools/dedupe_hybrid.py
--primary-hash-model q6b-fp32
--secondary-embed-model embed-3-small
--embed-threshold 0.92
--fuzzy-ngram 4
--bucket multilingual-long
--promote-golden-delta 0.18
```

labelops: agree with hybrid approach. for labeling: create an "ambig-multilang" queue for samples where hash!=match and embed in [0.88,0.92]. senior labelers only. label buckets of 40.

jorge: ok. also we should tag the run with dedupe_run=1751239999 and store both hash vectors in the index for audit.

curation-bot: job scheduled: hybrid-dedupe-1751239999 by jorge. status: scheduled.

rachel: i'll land a tiny change to index schema to persist token_hash_fp32 and token_hash_qint8 as separate fields (string). will PR and ask infra to approve quick.

mei: if anyone's running rescoring, prefer to run a small shard first to validate memory and latency. q6b-fp32 rescore tends to be ~30-50ms/token on small sequences, but long JSONs blow up.

jorge: started shard-1 rescoring. curating only multilingual-long bucket, 6 workers.

curation-bot: job started: hybrid-dedupe-1751239999-shard-1. workers=6.

labelops: preparing rubric. short bullets: 
- keep: true duplicate, exact same intent+answer even if whitespace/quotes differ
- merge: canonicalize (prefer ascii quotes, normalized emoji) then de-dupe
- suppress: noise/logs/stack traces with different runtime but same structure
examples attached in labeler guide doc link: https://redwood.internal/curation/1751239999/guide

rachel: quick status: shard-1 finished, index: s3://redwood-curation/hybrid/1751239999/shard-1.ndx. embeddings computed, avg embed cos computation 12ms/pair. no infra issues.

mei: good. i'll run the embed-similarity merge pass and output candidate groups.

curation-bot: candidate groups created: 1,204 groups, ambig queue: 312 samples.

labelops: assigning ambig-multilang: 8 batches x 39 = 312. ETA for label sweep ~5 hours (senior labelers on rotation).

jorge: note for golden refresh: only promote keep items where rescoring delta (q4b-int8 vs q6b-fp32) shows quality improvement >0.18 AND not previously in gold. otherwise write a note to gold-audit.

rachel: adding flag --gold-promote-strict to pipeline so we can run with conservative criteria.

mei: long term: we should canonicalize tokenization step pre-dedupe: normalize quotes, emoji zwj sequences, and NFKC normalize. that'll shrink this class of failures. I'll open a follow-up RFC.

jorge: solid. thanks everyone. i'll monitor canary metrics after golden refresh: hallucination rate, exact match on structured outputs, latency. will post results here. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

curation-bot: label batches created: 8. assigned: labelers-senior.

labelops: guide posted to thread and labeler channel. starting sweep now.

rachel: PR merged for schema fields. deploying to staging. tagging dedupe run in commit message.

mei: great. will draft the RFC for tokenizer normalization and also add tests for zwj/emoji sequences.

jorge: follow-up action items: 1) finish label sweep 2) merge keep items into gold with strict promote flag 3) run small canary and compare qint8 metrics 4) open RFC for canonicalization. assigning owners in internal tracker.

labelops: noted. ping if you need extra hands on labeling.

jorge: closing loop for now. will update when canary is live. thanks all.
